verdicts.reason: A is broken: the 'Find It Near You' CTA is shrunk to badge size and crammed into the top-left corner with the badges, 'SUMMER ONLY' wraps onto its own line, the teal circle is cut loose from the can and sits under the headline and body copy, and GLACIER now sits below the headline, so the reading order and hierarchy fall apart. B keeps the original's two-column structure and hierarchy, but the can now sits on the rim of the circle instead of inside it, the right column is spread out with big uneven gaps, and the top-left quarter is dead space, so it reads as a stretched layout, not a planned one.
